None of the 24 has a `Confirmation` section, so all 24 are no-`Confirmation` items and none has signal items. **Notes on the Terms:**
- **Date mentions:** No trigger has one. Ordinal-like numbers such as `RFC-0016` or `RFC-0034` sit right after a `-`, so they don't count. Issue numbers like `#5440`, `#1113` and `#618` are outside the 1900–2099 bare-year range.
- **"Confirmation section":** none of these ADRs has a `## Confirmation` heading. I took the Terms to mean the heading line must be exactly `## Confirmation`, so all 24 have `has_confirmation: false`.
- **Superseded ADR-0023:** it is named as a whole word in some Accepted headers in my share. ADR-0042 is its successor, so a match there is not a citation. The header-citation check needs the full set of Accepted records (ADR-0026 onward and the RFCs), which are outside my share, so I did not evaluate it.
- **Joined lines:** the Terms don't say whether continuation lines are trimmed before joining. None of the lines here has leading or trailing whitespace, so it makes no difference in this share.
